settings.contrast: delta_r = cor(CF459 WD, original FCG SD) - cor(CF459 WD, CF453 WD); positive means closer to original FCG SD on the same fixed edges
settings.cohort_age_labels: User-corrected 14 October 2026: CF459 3-month WD, original FCG 3-month SD, CF453 10-month WD. Age at sampling is user-supplied cohort provenance; no diet-duration or strain inference.
settings.age_report_note: Ages clarified by the user on 14 October 2026: CF459 male WD and original male FCG SD mice were 3 months old; CF453 male WD mice were 10 months old. These are ages at sampling, not established diet durations.
settings.age_figure_note: User-confirmed ages: CF459 WD 3 months; original FCG SD 3 months; CF453 WD 10 months.
settings.fixed_universe: Identical original WP3 strict shared 610-lipid male full/displayed edge universe; no new feature selection
settings.FCG_replay: Fresh original male RNA/log2-lipid matrices replay archived Figure 5 coefficients before matching by gene and exact reference_lipid
settings.null: 24 CF459 pairing permutations and existing 4999 empirical-marginal CF459 null draws conditional on fixed original FCG coefficients; two-sided absolute ULM equivalent to absolute r at fixed edge count
settings.paired: Original independent CF453/CF459 paired mouse banks reused; one additional independent FCG bank paired across RNA/lipids within 11 XXT and 11 XYT; the SAME CF459 draw enters both anchor comparisons and both zones
settings.direct_comparison: Observed delta and paired/omission delta stability are descriptive. Delta-positive bootstrap fraction is conditional on defined draws, not a null P or posterior probability.
settings.undefined: Any undefined frozen edge invalidates its entire coefficient vector; delta requires both anchor comparisons defined; no dynamic edge deletion
settings.exact_zero_null_correction: Integer source-identity contingency independence certifies all feature covariances mathematically zero; finite roundoff coefficients are set exactly zero, making coefficient-vector r undefined. No absolute coefficient threshold is used. Original WP3 null outputs are preserved and historical discrepancies recorded in null_degeneracy_ledger.
settings.omissions: Original 39 WD omission configurations plus all 22 original-FCG single omissions; both zones share indices
settings.nominal_ULM: Native intercept slope t; nominal edge-level P descriptive because edges share genes/lipids/mice
settings.limitations: FC459 n4, original selected FCG network, genotype/sample-size and cohort processing differences; age and diet are confounded across cohorts. No causal separation of age, diet, strain, diet duration or technical batch.
